standard.band_reference: ETSI TS 138 104 V17.14.0 band table is available at https://www.etsi.org/deliver/etsi_TS/138100_138199/138104/17.14.00_60/ts_138104v171400p.pdf

raw_observations.band_arfcn_consistency: Each observed raw ARFCN is consistently paired with the listed raw band in this release.

frequency_field.dictionary_meaning: wireless carrier center frequency used by the base station

agreement.conclusion: The two fields cannot be joined as the same NR-ARFCN without an undocumented release or encoding rule.

other_frequency_evidence.paper: The current paper says the handset was locked to N1 and N78. Its reproducibility text also says 'N1 and N78 (3.5 GHz)', which is imprecise wording because N1 is not a 3.5 GHz band; the audit preserves the source wording and does not silently correct it.
other_frequency_evidence.bandwidth: Base values are 100M for 166 rows, 40M for 10 rows, and 20M for 13 rows; the field does not resolve the raw/base frequency discrepancy.
other_frequency_evidence.direction: The public metadata does not state whether any frequency field is downlink center, carrier raster, duplex pair, or an internal operator identifier beyond the dictionary descriptions.

safe_source_fields: conditional 3GPP-derived raw frequency for analysis with provenance
do_not_do: do not apply a guessed constant offset
do not rewrite base values to match raw values
do not infer base field units from numeric plausibility
do not use label encoding as physical frequency

required_source_owner_clarifications: Define the units and coding of base Downlink Frequency and FREQUENCY.
State whether the base and raw records are from the same carrier snapshot and release.
Provide a carrier-level mapping from raw NR_ARFCN/band to each base-table cell.
Explain whether center frequency refers to downlink, uplink, carrier center, or an operator-internal field.
